# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [0.0.1] - 2026-09-20
### Added
- Created initial directory with basic structure following `typst-package-template`
- Created docs using Zensical
- Template matches KAMK's official thesis layout, but has not been verified against a real thesis yet.

## [0.0.2] - 2026-10-02
### Added
- A `todo` block a student can use to mark unfinished sections of their thesis.

### Changed
- Table has now thinner, grey strokes (border lines).

### Fixed
- The link to GitHub Pages Carlito guide is no longer broken.
